```sql
WITH sumrall_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Sumrall' AND border_type = 'city'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM sumrall_geom), true) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM sumrall_geom))
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(ST_Count(rast)) AS total_pixels,
    SUM(ST_Count(ST_Reclass(rast, '1=1 where pixel>460'))::int) AS above_460_pixels
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT
  ROUND((above_460_pixels * 100.0 / total_pixels)::numeric, 2) AS percent_above_460
FROM elevation_stats;
```
